links.source: Actual crates/hashed-ecdl-tensor through ic.hashed_native_v1; commit/image/binary/spec identities must be authenticated in checkpoint and Iso Lab receipts before execution.

question: Which native hashed-base backends complete independently verified one-target solves within fixed work/resource budgets on four registered small prime curves, and in which exclusive phase do incomplete attempts stop, alongside matched rho and bundled IC references?

claims.text: Every planned attempt is retained as a verified scalar or an explicitly recorded incomplete/invalid outcome; a resource limit is unknown, never a zero witness count or nonexistence proof.

General runtime gains, full arithmetic S rankings, statistical scaling/crossover, fastest-tool status, challenge scalars and the independent theorem/implementation audit are outside this initial feasibility protocol.

positive.expected_detection: The complete rho.negation_v2 positive control must recover and independently verify every same public target. It checks the workload/harness, not a population of native relation yields. Native known-answer and zero-budget controls remain mandatory development gates; any native resource failure is unknown, not a null finding.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Every public target belongs to a prime cyclic subgroup and has a logarithm; no no-solution population or nonexistence claim is tested. Explicit zero-budget/exhaustion and forged-witness controls are development gates, not success rows in this panel.

factors.name: curve
factors.value: prime_roster indices 10/12/14/16; actual field bits 10/12/14/16; all require registered ICV1 and readable EC1
factors.how: Registered=true required from ecbench plan; retain exact ICV1/EC1 and subgroup identities.

factors.name: targets
factors.value: 8 public targets per curve; hash_to_subgroup_v1; target_seed=2026103001
factors.how: 32 one-target workloads, sampled independently of arm; no target logarithm supplied to the native solver.

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: One release binary/image and source, resolved before execution in authenticated receipts
factors.how: All arms share the executable; bind source manifest, source checkpoint/readback, build-info, binary SHA-256, OCI digest, workflow SHA and spec hash. Null pre-build identity fields are not admission.

factors.name: threads
factors.how: Native observer is scoped and single-threaded; fixed thread environment; four-vCPU isolated pod retains housekeeping cores.

factors.name: native_policy
factors.value: All native arms share m=2, tau=32, 5M steps, vector=2M, columns=4096 and every explicit spec policy
factors.how: Only backend changes. Source uses the current unmodified reduction entry; unused backend-specific knobs are declared but do not change that entry. Partial outer threshold is min(2*tau,s).

factors.name: algorithm_seed
factors.how: ecbench derives one shared seed per workload/round from measurement.seed=2026103002, workload ID and absolute round; warmups use a separate domain.

factors.name: arm_order
factors.how: spec order=shuffle, deterministic Fisher-Yates per workload/round from the frozen seed.

factors.name: host
factors.value: one c8a.2xlarge EKS Spot worker; one epoch; 4GiB
factors.how: Record actual CPU/model/kernel/SMT/NUMA/frequency/cgroup/image and host class; no cross-host timing.

factors.name: host_load
factors.how: Every row retains L2 grade/blockers, CPU placement, steal/PSI and foreign activity; A/A is mandatory.

factors.name: warmup
factors.how: One warmup per workload/arm, retained but excluded by rule from measured comparisons.

factors.name: spot_interruption
factors.how: One original 1800s deadline including provisioning; zero retries/restores; incomplete/interrupted records retained, no restored timing.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Backend/error signatures reveal arm identity; report all rows and scope every observation, with no significance or speed claim.

seed_derivation.note: spec measurement.seed=2026103002; algorithm seed derive_u64(ecbench.algorithm_seed,[seed,workload_id_u64,absolute_round]), warmup uses ecbench.warmup_seed; all arms share the seed per workload/round. Shuffle order uses ecbench.order independently.

instance_sampling.rule: 32 public targets, 8 per registered prime_roster index 10/12/14/16, target_seed=2026103001, hash_to_subgroup_v1

blinding.how: Unblinded feasibility/correctness report, with all arms, failures and limits retained; no statistical significance decision.

power.note: C1 is exact verification/census of the frozen 1728 executions (1440 measured plus 288 warmup), not a power claim. Eight targets/curve do not establish a minimum detectable effect, scaling or general success probability. All comparative analyses are exploratory/out of scope for C2.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: No matched native runtime preflight is available before the required checkpoint/image gates. 1800 is the hard original job-budget ceiling, not a measured runtime prediction. This bounded first feasibility run records warmup/first-call behavior without adapting the frozen plan. No local test timing or unrelated fixture is substituted. This explicit bootstrap limitation is part of the protocol.

primary.name: Counted native group-call GAE
primary.definition: All native checked prime group calls, including identity/inverse cases, from curve setup through final internal replay. Scalar products are expanded into their group calls, never double charged. Other native arithmetic is not completely priced.

primary.name: S lower bound
primary.definition: Cold total counted GAE normalized by subgroup size; incomplete native arithmetic inventory makes this a lower bound.

secondary.name: Instrumented native cold solve wall
secondary.definition: Actual instrumented solve from observer/setup start through native return including all retries, failure work, elimination and internal replay. Runner process/startup/final independent verification are separately retained. Observer overhead is included and not calibrated away.
secondary.resolution: nanosecond clock field; effective resolution recorded by host

secondary.name: Unpriced native meter attempts
secondary.definition: All attempted meter charges by exclusive phase, including exhausted work; not calibrated primitive arithmetic and not a complete native-operation inventory.

stopping_rules.rule: Fixed design: 9 arms x 32 workloads x (1 warmup + 5 measured rounds) = 1728 executions. Each child has 30s and every native call a 5M-step bound. One original 1800s job deadline includes provisioning and the maintained harness quiet period.

Stop on the original deadline, interruption, input/integrity failure or execution/admission failure; preserve every partial artifact and row. Unknown native outcomes remain explicit; never drop them or extend the budget to obtain a full comparison.

invalidation_rules: a row with outcome.status other than verified is excluded from the decisive comparison and reported
a wall-time value on a row below L2 is descriptive only (wall_valid false); counted units stand at any level

decision_rule.text: Report exact attempted/verified/exhausted/error/interrupted flow per backend and curve, exclusive cost/failure stages, all scalars checked by the harness and exact replays. Any incomplete arm prevents a complete cross-arm cost comparison. Require all maintained L2/replay/A-A/S3 gates unchanged; their failure is an invalid/incomplete measurement, never a fast success. C2 remains out of scope regardless of exploratory ratios.
decision_rule.threshold: exact scalar validation and replay for every completed row; fixed budgets and intact admission for any timing
decision_rule.statistic: per-curve complete-row census and phase costs; exploratory paired totals only when complete
decision_rule.interval: none for exact C1; any exploratory ecbench paired-bootstrap interval is scoped to the sampled targets and admission
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: raw per-curve outcomes/counts; ratios only with complete verified pairs and full disclosure of unpriced work

inadmissible: Replacing this actual native arm with ic.tensor_contraction_v1 or an unrelated fixture
Changing source, workloads, parameters, order, seeds, unit, budgets, sample size or accounting after seeing data
Discarding failed/incomplete rows, ranking successful-only subsets as the full solve, or treating a resource limit as nonexistence
Launching without a fresh exact-source S3 checkpoint/readback and authenticated exact-image/native-execution admission
Reporting local development/preflight timings as this experiment, or pretending the hard budget ceiling is a measured runtime prediction
Treating diagnostic meter steps as a complete calibrated arithmetic price; all arms' unpriced counters must be shown at 0, 0.1 and 1 without promoting a full ranking
Claiming uninstrumented/native production speed, a scaling theorem/crossover, best external tool, or either Certicom challenge scalar
Replacing the original frozen native A/B study or its profiling; omitting the open binary end-to-end adapter, schoolbook full-pipeline integration, and independent general audit gaps
Automatic resubmission/retry, changing job identity after an ambiguous submission, or reusing an interrupted clock

literature.claim: Source fixed affine hash modulus and point-constraint reduction; no finite-size speed claim follows from its asymptotic theorem.
literature.verified_by: Prior native implementation review; pinned PDF section 3 and source constants retained in native docs.

literature.claim: Selector, width and partial implementations are finite bounded strategies; source packet theorem/guard is unchanged; binary domains and schoolbook primitives are not full measured pipelines.
Registered curves, shared seeds, all-phase counted units, L2/A-A, replay-all, incomplete comparisons and symmetric unpriced-work band.
Authenticated source/image/job/pod identity, fixed deadlines, S3 hash verification and zero automatic retries; no legacy fixture substitution.
